AETHER WIRELESS
Terms of Service & Network Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)
Document ID: POL-AETH-2026-V1 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Overview and Intent
Aether Wireless ("Company", "we", "us", or "our") is committed to delivering high-speed, reliable, and low-latency cloud-
native  5G/6G  connectivity  to  all  subscribers.  This  Acceptable  Use  Policy  ("AUP")  defines  the  rules  and  guidelines
governing the use of Aether Wireless's voice, data, text, and cloud network services (collectively, the "Services").
By accessing or using the Services, subscribers ("Users" or "Customers") agree to strictly adhere to the terms set forth in
this document.
2. Fair Usage Policy (FUP) & Bandwidth Governance
To  preserve  network  quality  and  avoid  congestion  for  all  subscribers,  Aether  Wireless  employs  dynamic  network
management practices across unlimited and tiered data plans.

Aether Wireless utilizes automated Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) solely for traffic prioritization and routing optimization.
Content payload data is never inspected or logged.

AETHER WIRELESS
Billing & Invoice Policy
Document ID: POL-AETH-BILL-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Billing Cycle & Statement Issuance
Aether Wireless issues monthly electronic statements on the 1st of each calendar month. Statements are made available
via the subscriber's online account portal and transmitted to the registered email address on file.
2. Payment Due Dates & Late Fees
Due Date: Payments are due exactly 21 days from the statement date.
Late Grace Period:  A 5-day grace period is granted following the due date. Accounts not settled within this window
are subject to a $5.00 late fee.
Service Interruption: Accounts overdue by more than 30 days may be subject to service suspension.
3. Disputed Charges
Subscribers  must  submit  billing  disputes  within  60  days  of  the  statement  date.  Disputes  should  be  directed  to
billing@aetherwireless.com with the subject line "Billing Dispute - [Account Number]".
4. Refund Policy
Refunds for overpayments or early servic

billing@aetherwireless.com with the subject line "Billing Dispute - [Account Number]".
4. Refund Policy
Refunds for overpayments or early service termination are processed within 10 business days and applied as a credit to
the subscriber's account or returned via the original payment method.

AETHER WIRELESS
Data Plan Terms & Conditions
Document ID: POL-AETH-DATA-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Plan Overview & Data Allowances
Each Aether Wireless data plan includes a specific monthly data allowance as outlined in the subscriber's service
agreement. Unused data does not roll over unless explicitly stated in the plan tier.
2. Data Speed & Throttling
Upon exceeding the monthly high-speed data allowance, data speeds may be reduced to a lower priority tier subject to
network availability. Fair Usage Policy (FUP) thresholds apply as defined in the Acceptable Use Policy.
3. International Roaming
Data roaming allowances vary by plan and destination country. Roaming rates and allowances are published in the rate
card and are subject to change with 30 days' notice.
4. Plan Changes
Subscribers may change their data plan at any time. Plan changes take effect on the next billing cycle. A pro-rated
adjustment may apply for mid-cycle upgrades.
5. Usage Monitoring

AETHER WIRELESS
Device Protection Policy
Document ID: POL-AETH-DEV-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Coverage Overview
Aether Wireless Device Protection provides coverage against accidental damage, malfunctions, theft, and loss for eligible
devices enrolled in the program.
2. Covered Events
Accidental Damage: Cracks, liquid damage, and other physical damage from drops or spills.
Mechanical Failure: Non-covered manufacturer defects after warranty expiration.
Theft & Loss: Replacement of lost or stolen devices subject to claim verification.
3. Deductibles
A service deductible applies to each approved claim, based on the device tier. Deductibles range from $29 to $199
depending on device model and protection tier selected.
4. Claims Process
Claims may be filed through the Aether Wireless portal, mobile app, or by calling customer support. An approved claim
results in a replacement device shipped within 1-3 business days.

AETHER WIRELESS
Device Trade-In Process
Document ID: POL-AETH-TRADE-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Eligibility Requirements
Trade-in devices must be fully functional, free of significant damage, and free of any outstanding financial obligations
under a device payment plan.
2. Trade-In Valuation
Trade-in values are determined based on device model, age, condition, and market value at the time of the trade-in
quote. Quotes are valid for 30 days.
3. Trade-In Steps
Request Quote: Obtain a trade-in valuation through the online portal or in-store.
Backup & Reset: Back up your data and perform a factory reset before shipping.
Ship Device: Package the device using the provided prepaid shipping label.
Receive Credit: Credit is applied to your account within 5 business days of device inspection.
4. Inspection & Adjustment
Received devices are inspected against the quoted condition. If discrepancies are found, the trade-in value may be
adjusted and the subscriber notified.

AETHER WIRELESS
Device Upgrade Guidelines
Document ID: POL-AETH-UPG-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Upgrade Eligibility
Subscribers are eligible for a discounted device upgrade once their device payment plan balance reaches 50% paid or
after 24 months of an active eligible plan. Eligibility is verified at the time of purchase.
2. Early Upgrade
Early upgrades may be available at full retail price with the remaining device balance folded into a new installment
agreement, or via eligible trade-in credit.
3. Upgrade Process
Confirm eligibility through the Aether Wireless portal or in-store.
Select a new device and review installment terms.
Complete the trade-in (if applicable) to offset the upgrade cost.
Receive and activate the new device on the existing line.
4. Fees & Taxes
Upgrade activation fees of $35 may apply and are disclosed prior to purchase. Applicable taxes are calculated at
checkout.

AETHER WIRELESS
Network Service Level Agreement (SLA)
Document ID: POL-AETH-NET-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Service Commitments
Aether Wireless guarantees the following minimum service levels for enterprise subscribers:
Metric Target Measurement Period
Network Uptime 99.95% Monthly
Average Latency < 15ms Monthly
Download Speed ≥ 500 Mbps (Premier) Monthly
Incident Response < 1 hour Per incident
2. Service Credits
If Aether Wireless fails to meet the guaranteed SLA metrics, subscribers are eligible for service credits:
Uptime below 99.95% but above 99.0%: 5% monthly credit
Uptime below 99.0%: 15% monthly credit
Uptime below 95.0%: 30% monthly credit + escalation to executive review
3. Scheduled Maintenance
Planned maintenance windows are communicated at least 72 hours in advance and are scheduled during off-peak hours
(2:00 AM - 5:00 AM local time) to minimize subscriber impact.

AETHER WIRELESS
New Line Activation Process
Document ID: POL-AETH-ACT-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Activation Overview
New line activations are available online, in-store, or via phone. The subscriber must select a compatible device and
approved plan for the new line.
2. Required Information
Identification: Valid government-issued photo ID for the account holder.
Credit Check: A soft credit check may be required for postpaid lines.
Compatibility: Device must support Aether Wireless network bands (5G/6G).
3. Activation Fees
A one-time activation fee of $35 applies per new line. Fees are waived during select promotional periods.
4. Activation Timeline
eSIM activations typically complete within minutes. Physical SIM activations complete upon delivery and SIM registration.
Number porting is handled separately per the Port-In Policy.

AETHER WIRELESS
Payment Eligibility Terms
Document ID: POL-AETH-PAY-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Payment Methods
Aether  Wireless  accepts  major  credit  cards,  debit  cards,  bank  transfers,  and  ACH  auto-pay.  PayAsYouGo  prepaid
vouchers are also redeemable online.
2. Auto-Pay Discounts
Subscribers enrolled in auto-pay with a valid bank account or credit card may qualify for a monthly discount of up to $10
per line, depending on the plan tier.
3. Eligibility Requirements
Account must be in good standing with no suspended services.
No outstanding balances from prior billing cycles.
Payment method must be verified and valid.
4. Payment Terms
Postpaid accounts are billed in arrears on a monthly cycle. Payment is due 21 days after statement issuance as defined
in the Billing & Invoice Policy.
5. Failed Payments
Failed payment attempts may incur a $5.00 returned payment fee. Repeated failures may result in service restriction
pending account settlement.

AETHER WIRELESS
Plan Upgrade Policy
Document ID: POL-AETH-PLAN-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Eligibility
Subscribers may upgrade their plan at any time provided the account is in good standing. Plan upgrades are effective
immediately or at the start of the next billing cycle, per subscriber preference.
2. Pro-Rated Adjustments
Mid-cycle upgrades are pro-rated, with the subscriber charged the difference between the old and new plan rates for the
remainder of the current billing cycle.
3. Data & Feature Availability
Upgraded plans unlock additional data allowances, roaming, and features (e.g., tethering, premium QoS) immediately
upon activation.
4. Downgrade Restrictions
Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle and may require forfeiture of promotional benefits associated
with the current plan.
5. Promotional Lock-In
Plans acquired under a promotional rate may have a lock-in period. Upgrading away from such plans may forfeit
remaining promotional benefits.

AETHER WIRELESS
Port-In Policy
Document ID: POL-AETH-PORT-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Overview
Number porting allows subscribers to transfer their existing phone number from another carrier to Aether Wireless while
retaining the same number.
2. Eligibility Requirements
The number must be active and in good standing with the current carrier.
The subscriber must provide the correct account number and PIN/transfer PIN.
No pending port-block requests on the number.
3. Porting Timeline
Ports typically complete within 1-3 business days. Wireless-to-wireless ports may complete within hours, while landline
ports may take up to 7 days.
4. Service Coverage During Port
A temporary number is assigned until the port completes. Service on the temporary number is seamless, and the ported
number replaces it upon completion.
5. Failed Ports
If a port fails due to incorrect information, the subscriber is notified and may resubmit with corrected details. Repeated
failures may require contact

AETHER WIRELESS
Postpaid Plan Guidelines
Document ID: POL-AETH-POST-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Overview
Postpaid plans provide monthly service billed in arrears after usage. They offer the flexibility of unlimited data tiers, device
financing, and premium features.
2. Credit Requirements
Postpaid enrollments require a credit assessment. Approval and deposit requirements are determined based on the
applicant's credit profile.
3. Billing
Postpaid accounts are billed on a monthly cycle. Payment is due 21 days from the statement date per the Billing &
Invoice Policy.
4. Device Financing
Eligible subscribers may finance devices over 12, 24, or 36 months at 0% APR subject to credit approval and plan
qualification.
5. Service Suspension
Accounts past due by more than 30 days may be subject to service suspension. Restoration requires full payment of the
outstanding balance plus any applicable reconnection fee.

AETHER WIRELESS
Privacy & Data Protection Policy
Document ID: POL-AETH-PRIV-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Data Collection & Usage
Aether Wireless collects personal and usage data solely for the purpose of delivering and improving our services. We
adhere to strict data minimization principles in compliance with applicable privacy regulations including GDPR and CCPA.
2. Data Sharing & Third Parties
We do not sell subscriber data to third parties. Data may be shared with trusted service providers solely for network
operations, billing, and customer support, under strict data processing agreements.
3. Data Retention
Subscriber data is retained only for the duration of the service relationship and for a period of 12 months following
account closure, unless longer retention is required by law.
4. Subscriber Rights
Subscribers have the right to access, correct, port, and request deletion of their personal data. Requests should be
directed to privacy@aetherwireless.com.

AETHER WIRELESS
Promotions Eligibility Terms
Document ID: POL-AETH-PROMO-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. General Eligibility
Promotional offers are available to new and existing subscribers subject to meeting the specific eligibility criteria of each
promotion. Offers may not be combined unless expressly stated.
2. New Customer Offers
New customer promotions require a new line activation and, where applicable, a qualifying trade-in device. Offer details,
duration, and credits are disclosed at the point of sale.
3. Existing Customer Offers
Existing customer promotions may require a plan upgrade, device upgrade, or add-a-line activation. Credits are applied
monthly over the promotion term.
4. Promotional Credits
Monthly promotional credits are applied to the bill and appear as line-item discounts. Credits cease if the qualifying plan
or device is changed before the term ends.
5. Expiration & Terms

AETHER WIRELESS
Returns & Refunds Policy
Document ID: POL-AETH-RET-001 Effective Date: September 1, 2026
1. Return Window
Devices and accessories purchased from Aether Wireless may be returned within 14 days of the original purchase date
for a full refund, subject to the terms below.
2. Return Conditions
Device must be undamaged and fully functional.
Original packaging, accessories, and documentation must be included.
No visible signs of wear or unauthorized modifications.
3. Restocking Fee
A restocking fee of up to $45 may apply to returns of devices that have been activated or show signs of use beyond initial
inspection.
4. Refund Processing
Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days of receiving and inspecting the returned item. Refunds are issued to
the original payment method.
5. Non-Returnable Items
Downloaded content, eSIM redemptions, and pre-loaded service credits are non-returnable and non-refundable once
activated.
